recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Capsule Royale: Goated Era**, a portrait-first browser battle royale shooter. Preserve the real loop: choose one of three classes, spawn in a square arena with nine bots, move with the left touch stick, aim/fire with the right touch stick, take projectile damage, display alive count and HP, win after eliminating all bots, lose on player death, and restart to class select.

Reinterpret the world as a satirical anime/cyberpunk chrome-dome battle royale inspired by futuristic biker energy without copying protected IP. The player is a chrome capsule hoverbike competing against meme-era clone drones. The UI should be mobile readable, fast to understand, and optimized for 4:7 to 9:16 portrait play.

Use procedural canvas/CSS visuals: red/cyan/magenta chrome palette, animated arena grid, speed-lane props, bold capsule silhouettes, distinct bot class forms, compact HUD cards, and clear CTA copy.

Prompt steering: Battle Royale. A satirical game inspired by Akira built around battle royale play, with competitive, futuristic, addictive energy, with friends session design, search-friendly hooks like battle royale, shooter, multiplayer, aesthetics like anime aesthetic, chrome aesthetic, cyberpunk, and meme-tone cues such as goated, era. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source is a portrait-first top-down battle royale shooter. The player chooses one of three classes, spawns in a square arena with nine bots, moves with the left touch stick, aims/fires with the right touch stick, takes projectile damage, and wins when all bots are eliminated or loses when player HP reaches zero.

## Protected Mechanics
- Three-class selection: scout, sniper, tank with the same hp/speed/damage/fire-rate/range/size values.
- One-thumb/two-zone mobile input semantics: left half movement, right half aim/fire.
- Bot targeting, strafing/back-away behavior, bullet speed, collision hit tests, arena bounds, HP damage, alive count, win/loss transitions, restart to class select.
- Canvas update loop and touch-action scoping to the canvas.

## Transformable Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/menu copy, procedural entity silhouettes, background grid/dome art, color roles, feedback words, SEO metadata, compact GIF/audio accents, and world framing are presentation-safe.

## Remix Target
Battle Royale. A satirical game inspired by Akira built around battle royale play, with competitive, futuristic, addictive energy, with friends session design, search-friendly hooks like battle royale, shooter, multiplayer, aesthetics like anime aesthetic, chrome aesthetic, cyberpunk, and meme-tone cues such as goated, era. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The rebuilt public surface is `index.html`; the old reference is `index_old.html`.
